instruction: Send a phone voice message to my all roommates, "I have taken out the trash.".
notes: Single-app task (phone). The roommates' identities are unknown up front, so they are modeled as abstract persons roommate-1 and roommate-2 (two roommates, consistent with the 6-call reference solution: passwords, login, one search_contacts with relationship=roommate, two send_voice_message calls, complete_task). Knowledge of roommates' phone numbers is modeled at the relationship level: one phone.search_contacts call with relationship 'roommate' makes (contacts-searched roommate) true, which unlocks sending to every person that has that relationship. The goal entities (roommate-1, roommate-2, the message) are domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can require every goal condition structurally; (not (voice-message-sent ?p ?m)) prevents duplicate sends, matching the evaluation's requirement of exactly one new voice message per roommate. If the real contact book has a different number of roommates, add/remove roommate-k constants and the corresponding init/goal facts.
